source: DOF Parking Violations Issued FY2020-FY2027, camera codes excluded. Harvest reconciled row-for-row to the City’s totals for all eight fiscal years. Addresses with a usable house number are placed exactly by LION address ranges. Addresses without one are apportioned fractionally along the named street’s address ranges, narrowed to the ticket’s precinct where given, across all layers including precincts and sectors. Apportioned and unresolvable shares are stored per layer per year.
